promptSet.title: Engineers Claude Companion (ECC) Overview & Features
promptSet.description:
Engineers Claude Companion (ECC) – Supercharge Claude Code with Engineers Claude Companion (ECC)

ECC is a game-changing developer companion for Claude Code CLI. It automatically runs background test watchers, enforces strict type checking, and flags dangerous terminal commands before execution.

Designed for developers and engineering teams, Engineers Claude Companion (ECC) accelerates implementation, eliminates repetitive development friction, and streamlines day-to-day coding workflows.

Key Features:
• Install ECC alongside Claude Code via npm install -g ecc-companion.
• Run ecc init in your project root directory.
• Watch Claude Code autonomously verify every code change against live tests.
• Terminal output demonstrating automated test verification pass with 0 failures.

GitHub Repository: https://github.com/
Instagram Breakdown: https://www.instagram.com/p/DY14MkbNknQ/
